blocker.name: Financial cancellation is not repeated by durable-output guard
sequence: First private V8 Gateway markVisible succeeds for exact native financial attempt; text A may publish.
Existing internal runtimeModelPolicy.cancelBudget sets run budget account cancelled=true and version+1, with Core run/outbox/lease/definition/grant/source unchanged.
Baseline next Gateway chunk freshly invokes markVisible→attemptContext→currentOperation; cancelled run financial account is rejected before Gateway enqueue.
A hypothetical successful-first-ACK shortcut instead enqueues chunk B into the official Agent/AI SDK pipeline.

Original recordOutput executes current executionContext/tool projection, but never reads the native model attempt/operation or financial account; no check observes this cancellation. It can insert B into runtimeAgentOutput.

Existing guardedObservation rechecks read/conversation/source/artifact/media/deadlines and reads runtimeAgentOutput, but does not inspect that financial cancellation. A fresh client session still passes. B can become visible.
blocker.baselineRefusal: currentOperation rejects cancelled run account at runtimeModelPolicy.ts:323–324; markVisible therefore fails before chunk emission.
blocker.candidateFailure: Returning the prior ACK is an authorization/currentness decision reuse at this boundary, despite later Agent grant/source/lease checks.

otherUnmatchedGuards: markVisible accepts only dispatch_pending or uncertain native financial attempt states.
currentOperation checks native operation cancellation/reference and financial run-account identity/cancellation.
currentOperation checks parent native-operation lineage, current pinned model/qualification/evidence compatibility and active tenant override actors.
recordOutput indirectly reruns executable-definition policy narrowing; this is retained and is not equivalent to exact native currentOperation.

officialPipeline.enqueueBeforeOnChunk: AI SDK7 eventProcessor enqueues current chunk before awaiting onChunk notification. Downstream reads are not gated by callback completion.
officialPipeline.componentPersistence: Official Agent consumes result.toUIMessageStream into DeltaStreamer; component addDelta/listDeltas can hold raw chunks. SDK does not expose syncStreams or a raw component-delta endpoint in the audited public runtime/client paths. This is private component storage, not evidence of an existing public raw-stream bypass.
officialPipeline.durablePublication: Private Agent flush publishes first text immediately, then batches up to32pending chunks or250ms, each through original recordOutput. Therefore per-chunk callback is not a per-chunk durable-currentness fence.
officialPipeline.tools: serverTools has no execute callback; tool work is routed through explicit Workflow begin/approval/start/tool guards and next model admission. Those remain current, but cannot retroactively replace the missing financial fence for prior emitted chunks.

visibilityFlags: First toolInputVisible acknowledgment cannot substitute for a later outputVisible=true transition (or the reverse) without changing original monotone financial evidence; premarking all flags would alter abort-after-first-ACK state. This is an additional constraint, not the primary rejection.
preserved: No change to first ACK-before-emit ordering, abort-after-ACK zero-output behavior, later original markVisible calls, recordOutput/tool/admission guards, UNKNOWN cost handling, deadlines, replay/fallback or JWT verification.
nextBoundary: A different optimization would need to re-execute the exact missing native currentOperation/attempt guards before every actual visible effect and prove all downstream/component exposure ordering. That is a separately scoped guard-relocation/composition change, not successful-ACK deduplication, and has not been implemented or authorized by this report.
evidenceKind: Read-only exact source/control-flow proof; no runtime counterexample test or hosted measurement was run.
